description: Saves what the person said a field is: one of its readings (reading, from get_review), the value they typed (value), that the document doesn't have it (not_in_document), or that the value as read is right (confirm); clear takes an answer back. Only their own answer, never your pick. A dispute they settle on a form is used on the account's next documents of that form.

clear.description: Take back an answer given before (the person changed their mind).

field.description: The field's path, as in get_review.

note.description: The person's words, if they gave a reason.

name: record_answer
title: Record the person's answer
